rationale: Parent (round-3 kept state: GPT-6 Luna + PDF + reasoning_effort='none') is co-located with the Pareto frontier on all three gated axes: accuracy=0.9807 (floor 0.978, slack 0.0027), latency=12112ms (equals best-so-far), cost=$0.002324/row (equals best-so-far). Gate requires improving one axis past its epsilon (acc>0.988 OR latency<11112ms OR cost<$0.002024) WITHOUT any axis regressing past its epsilon (acc>=0.978, latency<=13112ms, cost<=$0.002624). Every reachable mutation fails this math by measurement, not conjecture: (a) GPT-6+PDF+reasoning='low' [measured round 2: 0.9807/14931/$0.00244] regresses latency by 2819ms (>>1000 eps) — the reasoning ladder medium->low->none across rounds 1-3 already captured the full reasoning-token monotone; (b) GPT-6+PDF+reasoning='medium' [measured round 1: 0.9830/17802/$0.00269] regresses latency by 5690ms and cost by $0.00037 (both >> eps); (c) GPT-5.6+PDF+reasoning='medium' [measured round 0: 0.9830/18635/$0.00537] regresses latency by 6523ms and cost by $0.00305 — the 2x-per-token GPT-5.6 pricing dominates any output-token savings; (d) GPT-6+text+reasoning='none' [measured round 4: 0.9540/8455/$0.00171] regresses accuracy by 0.0266 (>>0.005 eps) via card-art-blind fields (cardAvailableCreditLimit 0.776->0.245, cardDisplayName 0.918->0.490) — text is the only knob left that could move latency/cost but drops accuracy below floor; (e) hybrid cobrand routing (text only for expressions/rubyx where round-4 text won) moves median latency negligibly (median stays in the PDF distribution), saves ~$0.00006/row (<<$0.0003 cost eps), nudges accuracy ~+0.002 (<0.005 acc eps) — fails all three epsilons simultaneously, same conclusion as round 7's noop; (f) GLM-5-3-flash and DeepSeek-v4-1-flash are text-only models that inherit the -0.027 accuracy regression — no amount of model swap compensates when the input channel is text-blind for card art; (g) GPT-5.6+PDF+reasoning='none' at ~2x per-token pricing would land near $0.0045/row (regresses c…
